title: Research programme and team responsibilities
text: The group discussion assigns a public-health research programme: Namdev leads the overall study and AMR strategy; Tanishq covers hardware and feasibility; Mahima develops research data and accessibility analysis; Herambh develops policy and implementation; Vishwajee develops scenarios and the public-welfare narrative. [S27]

These responsibilities complement the project's earlier founding and engineering roles. Maintain a shared evidence table, a list of unresolved assumptions and a dated decision log so that different submissions use consistent claims.

Outputs could include a source-backed diagnostic-capacity study, a costed pilot plan and a sensitivity-tested preparedness scenario. These are planned research deliverables; no government partnership, funded programme or clinical outcome is implied.
